sanity_expectations: N(t) is finite and non-negative for all t in [0, 40]
N(t) grows monotonically or near-monotonically from IC=20 toward an equilibrium near carrying_capacity=200 (allee_threshold=10 is below IC so no low-density collapse)
experienced_mate_abundance(t) tracks N(t) with a lag on the order of mate_encounter_memory_time=5
unmated_fraction(t) decreases from 1 toward a small positive equilibrium as N (and thus mate encounters) grows
mating_type_fraction(t) drifts slowly from 0.6 toward 0.5 (frequency-dependent selection) but stays well above 0.5 within the sampling window given large mate_encounter_scale
dN_dt is positive during the growth phase and approaches 0 as N approaches its equilibrium
excitation_report: Full child-vs-parent ODE-system comparison on the N trajectory, sigma=0.5, k=5. new_term_max_effect = 20.90 (peak trajectory deviation of N due to the new mating-type-modulation term), i.e. 41.8*sigma, strongest near t≈1.0. Passes: True. The three original terms (baseline logistic growth, allee lower threshold, unmated-fraction loss) are all inherently active in the trajectory (N is driven from below carrying_capacity to near K, dN_dt of order 4-10 through the transient, ≫ 5*sigma=2.5).

rationale: Typed ODE contract inherited verbatim (state order, RHS, ICs, parameters). Time range [0, 40] chosen so N grows from IC=20 through the sweet spot near carrying_capacity/2 and approaches K — this is where N*(1-N/K) is largest and the new p-modulated growth term differs most from the parent. allee_threshold=10 places IC above threshold so the growth trajectory is sampled (recovery-and-crowding regime). Large mate_encounter_scale (100) and dispersion_shape (3) slow the drift of mating_type_fraction from 0.6 toward 0.5, keeping (1 - 4p(1-p)) above ~0.04 throughout. Excitation check on the full child-vs-parent system confirms the new mating-type modulation moves the N trajectory by 20.9 units (~42*sigma) around t≈1, well above the 5*sigma bar. All parameters kept physically reasonable (dimensionless shape 3, times of order 3-5, capacities in dozens to hundreds).
